Scenario fixture: viewport-zoom-review (RGAA 10.4.2)

01 — CANTTELL: viewport meta sets user-scalable=no

The rule reads the document's own <meta name="viewport">, so one page shows one scenario. RGAA 10.4.2 passes when text reaches 200% with the browser text zoom, the browser graphic zoom or a zoom control of the site, so a tag that blocks pinch zoom is a question, not a failure. The notApplicable cases (no restriction, no viewport meta) are in the rule's test file.
